Uaireanta is féidir guthanna "caillte" a fháil agus stop a chur le feiceáil ar an bhfeiste. [[ If your device supports Speech Synthesis, it should have one or more voices installed by default. Sometimes voices can get "lost" and stop appearing on the device.
file_uploads_info: Ní thacaíonn gach brabhsálaí leis na gnéithe uaslódála comhad nua-aimseartha a úsáideann %app_name%. file_storage_info: Ligeann gléasanna agus roinnt brabhsálaithe duit comhaid a stóráil le húsáid as líne. Mura bhfuil an ghné seo ar fáil, is féidir roinnt comhad a stóráil sa bhunachar sonraí ach seans go mbeidh earráidí stórála agat. indexed_db_info: Is uirlis stórála é IndexedDB a úsáidtear chun cláir agus inneachar cláir a íoslódáil ionas gur féidir le %app_name% oibriú go fóill fiú gan nasc Idirlín. Má éiríonn cuimhne an ghléis lán uaireanta scriosfar na bunachair shonraí seo go huathoibríoch (agus gan choinne). [[ IndexedDB is a storage tool used to download boards and board contents so that %app_name% can still work even without an Internet connection. If the device's memory gets full sometimes these databases will be automatically (and unexpectedly) deleted.
sqlite_info: Is uirlis stórála eile é SQLite a úsáidtear chun cláir agus inneachar cláir a íoslódáil ionas gur féidir le %app_name% oibriú go fóill fiú gan nasc Idirlín. Níl bunachair shonraí SQLite ar fáil ar an oiread gléasanna, ach ní scriosfar iad gan chead. [[ SQLite is another storage tool used to download boards and board contents so that %app_name% can still work even without an Internet connection. SQLite databases aren't available on as many devices, but won't get deleted without permission.
media_recording_info: Ligeann Taifeadadh Meáin duit pictiúir a ghlacadh agus fuaim a thaifeadadh trí úsáid a bhaint as ceamara gréasáin do ghléis. Úsáideann roinnt gléasanna soghluaiste a n-uirlisí taifeadta meán ionsuite féin in ionad taifeadáin %app_name%. [[ Media Recording allows you to take pictures and record audio using your device's webcam. Some mobile devices use their own built-in media recording tools instead of %app_name%'s recorders.
xhr_cors_info: Chun oibriú as líne, ní mór do %app_name% íomhánna a íoslódáil ó láithreáin ghréasáin iolracha. Níl XHR/CORS ag teastáil le go n-oibreoidh sé seo, ach déanann sé an próiseas íoslódála níos éifeachtaí. [[ In order to work offline, %app_name% needs to download images from multiple web sites. XHR/CORS is not required for this to work, but it makes the download process more efficient.
canvas_info: Ligeann %app_name% duit íomhánna a bhearradh agus a dhathú chun do riachtanais cláir a mheaitseáil níos fearr, agus úsáideann sé rud ar a dtugtar an eilimint Canbhás chun é sin a dhéanamh. valet_login_explainer: Ligeann logáil isteach Valet duit ainm úsáideora agus pasfhocal sealadach a roinnt lasmuigh de ghléas iontaofa gan do chuntas iomlán a nochtadh. [[ Valet login allows you to share a temporary username and password outside of a trusted device without exposing your full account. goals_explainer1: Is bealach iad na spriocanna chun cabhrú leis an gcumarsálaí agus lena bhfoireann tacaíochta a straitéisí reatha a choinneáil i mbarr a réime. Is féidir leo a bheith ginearálta cosúil le "Cuimhnigh focail lárnacha a úsáid!" nó sainiúil ar nós "Bain úsáid as beannachtaí agus tú ag dul isteach i suíomh nua". Cuimhnigh gur féidir gur spriocanna iad seo don chumarsáidí ("Freagair ceisteanna agus tá nó níl"), nó don fhoireann tacaíochta timpeall an chumarsáide ("Úsáid ordlathas leideanna"). [[ Goals are a way to help the communicator and their support team keep their current strategies top of mind. They can be general like "Remember to use core words!" or specific like "Use greetings when entering a new setting". Remember, these can be goals for the communicator ("Answer questions with yes or no"), or for the support team around the communicator ("Use a prompting hierarchy").
goals_explainer2: Is féidir spriocanna a rianú do gach cumarsáidí trí úsáid a bhaint as measúnuithe, nó nuair a bhíonn nótaí á ndéanamh ar logaí úsáideora. Úsáidtear na nuashonruithe stádais seo ansin chun tuairisc ghinearálta a thaispeáint ar an gcaoi a bhfuil an sprioc ag dul chun cinn le himeacht ama. [[ Goals can be tracked for each communicator using assessments, or when making notes on a user's logs. These status updates are then used to show a general report of how the goal is progessing over time.

coaching_lead: Straitéisí comhpháirtíochta bunaithe ar fhianaise chun cabhrú leis an sprioc seo a bhaint amach. [[ Evidence-based partner strategies to help reach this goal.
coaching_model_title: Múnla ar an ngléas [[ Model on the device
coaching_model_body: Tapáil na focail sprice ar an gcóras AAC agus tú ag labhairt — taispeáin, ná fiafraigh. Seo í Spreagadh Teanga Cuidithe, an straitéis samhaltaithe AAC is fearr. [[ Tap target words on the AAC system while you speak — show, don't ask. This is Aided Language Stimulation, the gold-standard AAC modeling strategy.
coaching_wait_title: Fan ar a laghad 10 soicind [[ Wait at least 10 seconds
coaching_wait_body: Tar éis samhaltú, sos go ciúin ar feadh 10+ soicind. Is minic a bhíonn am próiseála breise ag teastáil ó úsáideoirí AAC chun a bhfreagra a phleanáil agus a chur i gcrích. [[ After modeling, pause silently for 10+ seconds. AAC users often need extra processing time to plan and execute their response.
coaching_routines_title: Cuir isteach i ngnáthaimh laethúla [[ Embed in daily routines
coaching_routines_body: Tóg an sprioc isteach in am sneaiceanna, aistrithe, súgradh agus ullmhú — chuimhneacháin nádúrtha ina bhfuil an focal ar an gceann is úsáidí sa seomra. [[ Build the target into snack time, transitions, play, and getting ready — natural moments where the word is the most useful one in the room.
coaching_generalize_title: Ginearálú trasna comhpháirtithe agus áiteanna [[ Generalize across partners and places
coaching_generalize_body: Cinntigh go bhfuil an scil le feiceáil le comhpháirtithe cumarsáide éagsúla, i suíomhanna éagsúla, i ngníomhaíochtaí éagsúla — ní hamháin sa teiripe. [[ Make sure the skill shows up with different communication partners, in different settings, across different activities — not just in therapy.
coaching_celebrate_title: Neartaigh iarracht, ní foirfeacht [[ Reinforce effort, not perfection
coaching_celebrate_body: Aithin gach iarracht. Logáil seisiúin le Measúnú Tapa ionas go mbeidh an fás le feiceáil le himeacht ama, ní thomhaistear é de réir nóiméid amháin. [[ Recognize every attempt. Log sessions with Quick Assessment so growth is visible over time, not measured by a single moment.

inflections_tool_explainer: Is uirlis foinse oscailte é %app_name% a thacaíonn le hiliomad teangacha agus idirghníomhaíochtaí. Ligeann an Uirlis Athbhreithnithe Inflections dúinn faisnéis a bhailiú ó fhoinsí iolracha agus muid ag tógáil amach liostaí focal teanga. Cuidíonn eolas cruinn ar fhoirmeacha focal linn tacaíocht níos fearr a thabhairt dár bpobail. Cuimhnigh, déanfar an fhaisnéis go léir a bhailíonn an uirlis seo a scaoileadh saor in aisce ar líne le ceadúnas oscailte do dhaoine eile le húsáid agus le leas a bhaint aisti. [[ %app_name% is an open source tool that supports multiple languages and interactions. This Inflections Review Tool allows us to collect information from multiple sources as we build out language word lists. Having accurate information on word forms helps us better support our communities. Remember, all information collected by this tool will be released for free online with an open license for others to use and benefit from.
inflections_tips: TIPS: Tá cineálacha iolracha ag roinnt focal. Tá cineálacha malartacha áirithe chomh doiléir sin nach fiú go mór iad a áireamh, smaoinigh ar cad a déarfadh cainteoir meánach. Má tá an focal infhillte cheana féin ("lorg") déan cinnte a fhréamh ("féach") a chur isteach sa chéad bhosca. Ní bhíonn ciall le roinnt infhilleadh do bhriathra/dobhriathar áirithe, cuir “N/B” sa bhosca le do thoil. Maidir le codarsnachtaí, déan an ceann is soiléire más ann dóibh. Mura bhfuil tú cinnte faoi fhocal, ná bíodh eagla ort é a scipeáil! [[ TIPS: Some words have multiple types. Some alternate types are so obscure that they're not really worth including, think about what an average speaker might say. If the word is already inflected ("looking") make sure to enter its root ("look") in the first box. Some inflections for certain verbs/adverbs don't make sense, please put "N/A" in the box. For opposites, just do the most obvious if any. If you're unsure about a word, don't be afraid to skip it!

core_1: Coincheap tábhachtach amháin le AAC ná focail “lárnacha”. Is focail iad croífhocail a úsáidimid go minic sa chumarsáid laethúil, agus is féidir le bríonna iolracha a bheith acu. core_2: Samhlaigh dá mbeadh gach a d'fhéadfá a rá frásaí réamhshainithe mar "Tá ocras orm", "Tá mé tuirseach", nó "Déanaimis é sin arís." Conas a chuirfeá ceist ar dhuine éigin faoina lá? [[ Imagine if all you could say were predefined phrases like "I'm hungry", "I'm tired", or "Let's do that again." How would you ask someone about their day? dwell_1: Maidir le cumarsáidí gan rialú mótair comhsheasmhach, uaireanta is féidir le rianaithe súl a bheith ina modh rochtana éifeachtach. Is ceamara speisialta é rianaire súl a rianaíonn gluaiseachtaí súl. Nuair a fhanann cuma chumarsáide ar chnaipe ar feadh tréimhse ama, is féidir leis an gcóras an cnaipe sin a roghnú thar ceann an chumarsáidí. De rogha air sin, is féidir le córais áirithe gluaiseacht cloisteála nó coirp a rianú ag baint úsáide as ceamaraí nó braiteoirí chun an cúrsóir luiche a chóireáil mar luamhán stiúrtha, agus nuair a bhíonn an cúrsóir "ina chónaí" thar chnaipe, roghnaítear é. Is féidir le rianú súl nó áitribh a bheith níos tapúla ná rochtain lasc, ach tá sé níos deacra é a chalabrú i gceart. [[ For communicators without consistent motor control, eye trackers can sometimes be an effective access method. An eye tracker is a special camera that tracks eye movements. When a communicator's gaze lingers on a button for a period of time, the system can select that button on behalf of the communicator. Alternatively, some systems can track hear or body movement using cameras or sensors to treat the mouse cursor like a joystick, and when the cursor "dwells" over a button, it is selected. Eye or dwell tracking can be faster than switch access, but is more difficult to calibrate correctly.
dwell_2: Is féidir le %app_name% oibriú le haon rianaitheoir súl nó córas a thacaíonn le rialú cúrsóra (tá tástáil déanta againn ar Tobii, MyGaze, eyetech agus LC Technologies, agus crua-earraí EagleEyes). Níl le déanamh ach "cliceáil" a dhíchumasú ó láimhseálann %app_name% iad seo leis féin. Is féidir leat mionchoigeartú a dhéanamh ar na socruithe rianaithe ar amharc "Sainroghanna" an úsáideora. Beidh cumraíocht bhreise de dhíth ar roinnt córas, cosúil le EyeTribe agus EyeX, i "Sainroghanna" freisin. modeling_ideas_intro_1: An raibh a fhios agat go bhfoghlaimíonn cumarsáidí nua focail a chur le chéile trí bhreathnú ar dhaoine eile é a dhéanamh ar dtús? Nó go molann saineolaithe AAC suas le 80% den chumarsáid le húsáideoir nua a bheith múnlaithe ar fheiste? [[ Did you know that new communicators learn to combine words by observing others do it first? Did you know that babies hear thousands of hours of spoken language before speaking on their own? Or that AAC experts recommend up to 80% of communication with a new user be modeled on a device?
modeling_ideas_intro_2: Tá sé an-tábhachtach samhaltú, nó samplaí de conas cnaipí a bhualadh chun cumarsáid a dhéanamh! Agus tú ag tosú ag obair le cumarsáidí atá ag baint úsáide as AAC, lorg seansanna focail éagsúla, nó na focail chéanna a shamhaltú ar bhealaí éagsúla. B’fhéidir go dtógfaidh sé cleachtadh le bheith compordach nó le torthaí a fheiceáil, ach tá léirithe ag taighde arís agus arís eile cé chomh mór is atá samhaltú difriúil! [[ Modeling, or showing examples of how to hit buttons to communicate, is very important! As you start work with communicators who are using AAC, look for chances to model different words, or the same words in different ways. It may take practice to get comfortable or to see results, but research has shown over and over how much of a different modeling makes!

[[ -- through no fault of their own. Many people need the assistance of technology in order for their voices to be heard. Unfortunately, a lot of that technology is hard to use, is hard to configure, and is crazy expensive. %app_name% is a new AAC app that tries to fix that.
why_lingolinq: Cén fáth "%app_name%"? Tagann an t-ainm LingoLinq ón smaoineamh teanga a nascadh leis na daoine a bhfuil géarghá acu léi. Creidimid go bhfuil guth tuillte ag gach duine -- ceann atá éasca le húsáid, inacmhainne agus chomh nádúrtha sin nach smaoiníonn aon duine air faoi dhó. Is mian linn réitigh shimplí, sochaideartha a sholáthar ar riachtanais chasta chumarsáide a oibríonn le húsáid laethúil. [[ Why "%app_name%"? The name LingoLinq comes from linking language to the people who need it most. We believe everyone deserves a voice -- one that’s easy to use, affordable to access, and so natural that nobody thinks twice about it. We want to provide approachable, simple solutions to complex communication needs that work for everyday use.
the_challenge_text: Some people need help being heard -- and the tools out there? Often clunky, confusing, and way too expensive.
our_mission_text: LingoLinq means linking language to the people who need it most. Everyone deserves a voice that's easy to use, affordable, and just works.
our_mission_closer: That's what LingoLinq is all about.
landing_cta_subtitle_intro: Start with our free tier. No credit card, no hardware, no commitment.
learn_as_you_go: Foghlaim mar a Théann Tú [[ Learn as You Go
learn_as_you_go_content_1: Mura bhfuil tú nua i saol na cumarsáide méadaithe, mothaíonn beagnach gach cuid di imeaglaithe. Cén chaoi a mbeadh a fhios agat, b’fhéidir, na focail agus na siombailí cearta le roghnú do riachtanais phearsanta (agus mianta, agus dóchas agus mianta) an duine. Gan a bheith buartha, oibrímid le go leor speisialtóirí éagsúla chun teimpléid dea-thaighde a chur ar fáil a chuirfidh tús leat. Agus chomh tábhachtach céanna, cuirimid acmhainní oiliúna ar fáil do thuismitheoirí, cúramóirí, siblíní... tá a fhios ag gach duine a bhfuil baint aige le tacú le duine cad atá ar siúl agus conas go díreach is féidir leo cabhrú leis na straitéisí cumarsáide a bheith rathúil. [[ If you're new to the world of augmentative communication, just about every part of it feels intimidating. How could you possibly know the right words and symbols to pick for an individual's personal needs (and wants, and hopes, and wishes). Not to worry, we work with many different specialists to provide well-researched templates that will get you started. And just as importantly, we provide training resources for parents, caregivers, siblings... everyone involved in supporting an individual deserves to know what's going on and how exactly they can help the communication strategies be successful.
offline_content_1: Is iontach an rud é sonraí a bhailiú agus oibriú trasna gléasanna, ach tá neart áiteanna fós ann nach mbeidh nasc maith Wi-Fi agat. Stórálann %app_name% cláir agus logaí úsáideora ar gach gléas ionas gur féidir leis an úsáideoir cumarsáid a dhéanamh as líne gan aon bhriseadh. Sioncrónaíonn gach rud cúltaca an chéad uair eile a bhíonn nasc idirlín ann. [[ Gathering data and working across devices is great, but there are still plenty of places where you won't have a good Wi-fi connection. %app_name% stores a user's boards and logs on each device so the user can communicate offline with no interrupts. Everything syncs back up the next time there is an internet connection.
personalization: Pearsanú agus Sioncronú [[ Personalization and Sync
personalization_content_1: Tá sé contúirteach a bheith ceangailte le gléas amháin, go háirithe nuair atá go leor de do chuid pictiúr féin curtha leis agat nó nuair a bhog tú siombailí pictiúir timpeall le haghaidh úsáide pearsanta. Ní hamháin gur féidir leat do shonraí agus do chumraíocht a chailleadh, ach má scoilteann scáileán nó ceallra bás, níl an t-ádh leat go dtí gur féidir é a athsholáthar. Oibríonn %app_name% thar ghléasanna iolracha agus coinníonn sé an t-inneachar i sioncronú duit ionas nach gá duit a bheith buartha. [[ Being tied to a single device is risky, especially when you've added lots of your own pictures or moved picture symbols around for personal use. Not only can you possibly lose your data and configuration, but if a screen cracks or a battery dies, you're out of luck until it can be replaced. %app_name% works across multiple devices and keeps content in sync for you so you don't have to worry.
create_share: Cruthaigh, Roinn agus Athúsáid [[ Create, Share and Reuse
create_share_content_1: Níl aon duine ag iarraidh tosú ón tús agus sraith clár cumarsáide á chruthú. Ligeann %app_name% duit cláir chumarsáide cruthaithe ag daoine eile a aimsiú agus a phearsantú go héasca. Agus spreagann %app_name% ceadúnais oscailte ábhair agus siombailí, mar sin ní gá duit a bheith ag smaoineamh an bhfuil cóipcheart á bhriseadh agat áit éigin de thimpiste. [[ Nobody wants to start from scratch when creating a set of communication boards. %app_name% lets you easily discover and personalize communication boards created by others. And %app_name% encourages open licenses of content and symbols, so you don't have to wonder if you're breaking copyright somewhere on accident.
open_board_support: Tá %app_name% tiomanta do chláir a oscailt agus in-athúsáidte. Chomh mór sin gur thosaigh muid an tionscnamh OpenBoards chun oibriú i dtreo formáid comhaid chaighdeánach le haghaidh boird a allmhairiú agus a easpórtáil thar gach aip agus gléas, agus úsáidimid an fhormáid sin mar ár bhformáid dúchais iompórtála/onnmhairithe. Nuair a bhíonn an tsaoirse againn tógáil ar smaointe agus ar rath a chéile is cuma cén áit ar tháinig siad, bíonn an bua ag gach duine. [[ %app_name% is committed to making boards open and reusable. So much so that we started the OpenBoards initiative to work toward a standard file format for importing and exporting boards across all apps and devices, and we use that format as our native import/export format. When we have the freedom to build off of each other's ideas and successes regardless of where they came from, everyone wins.
coordination_content_1: Is uafásach an rud é gléas cumarsáide duine aonair a thógáil uathu chun é a ríomhchlárú, tógann sé a nguth. Ligeann %app_name% do theiripeoirí, speisialtóirí, tuismitheoirí agus baill foirne eile an tacar cumarsáide a mhodhnú agus fiú nótaí seisiúin agus teachtaireachtaí a logáil in áit inar féidir le gach duine leas a bhaint astu. [[ Having to take an individual's communication device away from them in order to program it is a terrible thing, it takes away their voice. %app_name% lets therapists, specialists, parents and other team members modify the communication set and even log session notes and messages in a place where everyone can benefit from them.
insights_content_1: Uaireanta bíonn sé deacair a fháil amach cad atá ag obair agus cad nach bhfuil. Is próiseas leanúnach é cumarsáid mhéadaithe chun stór focal a mhodhnú agus a thabhairt isteach, agus gan tuairiscí maithe is deacair a bheith cinnte cad is gá a athrú. Is féidir le %app_name% gach cumarsáid a logáil agus tuairiscí léargasacha a sholáthar bunaithe ar am, suíomh agus stór focal a fhágann go mbeidh sé níos soiléire do gach duine cén áit ar cheart dóibh a n-iarrachtaí a dhíriú chun na torthaí is fearr a bhaint amach. [[ Sometimes it's really hard to know what's working and what's not. Augmentative communication is an ongoing process of modifying and introducing vocabulary, and without good reports it's difficult to be sure what needs to change. %app_name% can log all communications and provide insightful reports based on time, location and vocabulary that makes it clearer for everyone just where to focus their efforts for the best results.
learn_as_you_go_catchphrase: Expert-designed templates and training so you never start from scratch.
work_offline_catchphrase: Communicate anywhere -- boards and logs sync when you reconnect.
personalization_catchphrase: Your setup follows you across every device, always up to date.
create_share_catchphrase: Discover boards, share openly, and build on each other's work.
coordination_catchphrase: Therapists and families collaborate without taking the device away.
insights_catchphrase: Clear reports that show what's working and where to focus next.
trust_transparency_text: We're talking about someone's voice -- potentially everything they ever say. That's deeply personal, and we treat it that way. Your data is encrypted, never shared without permission, and always yours to export.
security_content_1: Soláthraíonn %app_name% cumarsáid agus stóráil shlán ar gach clár, loga agus faisnéis úsáideora. Ní roinnimid faisnéis phríobháideach amhail sonraí úsáideoirí, cláir phríobháideacha agus logaí úsáide gan cead sainráite. Glacaimid príobháideacht an úsáideora thar a bheith dáiríre mar, ag deireadh an lae, is é an rud a bhfuilimid ag caint faoi go bhféadfaí gach rud a deir duine a thaifeadadh riamh. Tá an cineál sin faisnéise tuillte a chosaint. [[ %app_name% provides secure communication and storage of all boards, logs and user information. We do not share private information like user data, private boards and usage logs without explicit permission. We take user privacy extremely seriously because, at the end of the day, what we're talking about is potentially recording everything an individual ever says. That kind of information deserves to be protected.
open_source_content_1: Tá an chuid is mó de na córais AAC tógtha ar theicneolaíocht dhílseánaigh, rud a chiallaíonn nach bhfuil a fhios agat i ndáiríre cé chomh slán agus atá siad, tá sé níos éasca a bheith faoi ghlas agus iallach a chur ar a mbealach chun rudaí a dhéanamh. Is foinse oscailte é %app_name% agus tógadh le meon oscailte, ionas gur féidir leat a fheiceáil duit féin cad a théann isteach sa chóras, agus bíonn rochtain éasca agat agus easpórtálacha ar do shonraí go léir i gcónaí. [[ Most AAC systems are built on proprietary technology, which means you don't really know how secure they are, it's easier to get locked in and forced into their way of doing things. %app_name% is open source and built with an open mindset, so you can see for yourself what goes into the system, and you always have easy access and exports for all your data.

robust_1: D’fhéadfadh cuma rud beag imeaglach a bheith ar stór focal láidre ar dtús, ach is féidir gur tacair chumhachtacha teanga iad ar féidir leis an gcumarsóir fás orthu le himeacht ama. Déan iarracht díriú níos mó ar cé mhéad cnaipí is féidir leis an gcumarsóir a rochtain go rathúil seachas cé chomh gnóthach is atá an scáileán, mar is féidir leat cnaipí a cheilt i gcónaí agus pleanáil chun iad a athchumasú níos déanaí. Féadfaidh na tacair cláir seo béim a chur ar phleanáil mhótair nó ar chumarsáid phragmatach, ach tá cnuasach maith croífhocail agus sainfhocail acu go léir, agus spás le haghaidh stór focal pearsantaithe freisin. [[ Robust vocabularies may seem a little intimidating at first, but they can be powerful language sets that the communicator can grow into over time. Try to focus more on how many buttons the communicator can successfully access rather than how busy the screen is, because you can always hide buttons and plan to re-enable them later. These board sets can have an emphasis on motor planning or pragmatic communication, but all have a good collection of core and specialized words, and room for personalized vocabulary as well.
cause_effect_1: Maidir le cumarsáidí atá úrnua do AAC, bíonn sé tairbheach uaireanta tosú le bord neamhchumarsáide, díreach chun cabhrú leo a fhoghlaim gur féidir leo cnaipí a bhuail agus go dtarlóidh rudaí. Is féidir leis na cláir chúise agus éifeachta seo cabhrú le cumarsáidí a oiliúint conas a modh rochtana a úsáid ar bhealach spraíúil. [[ For communicators that are brand-new to AAC, sometimes it's beneficial to start with a non-communication board, just to help them learn that they can hit buttons and things will happen. These cause-and-effect boards can help train communicators how to use their access method in a fun way.
simple_starts_1: I gcás roinnt cumarsáide is féidir le tosú le sraith bheag de chnaipí simplí cabhrú leo a bheith compordach ag baint úsáide as AAC. [[ For some communicators starting with a small set of simple buttons can help them get comfortable using AAC. functional_1: Uaireanta is féidir le béim ar chumarsáid níos feidhmiúla a bheith luachmhar do chumarsáidí. Brabhsáil an liosta le haghaidh aon chroífhocail a d’fhéadfadh ciall a bhaint as don chlár reatha. [[ Core words are frequently-used words that often have multiple meanings or intents. fringe_explainer: Is focail speisialaithe nó sainiúla iad imeallfhocail, cosúil le daoine nó cineálacha bia. Brabhsáil na catagóirí chun focail a aimsiú nó faigh smaointe d’fhocail a d’fhéadfaí a chur leis an gclár reatha. [[ Fringe words are specialized or specific words, like people or types of food. Communicators should have access to fringe words that represent their interests, connections, and things they are learning about. Browse the categories to find words or get ideas for words that could be added to the current board.
recordings_explainer: D’fhéadfadh sé a bheith úsáideach do chumarsáideoirí áirithe focail nó frásaí a thaifeadadh a bheidh siad ag iarraidh a úsáid ar bhealach níos éasca sa todhchaí. Is féidir leat frásaí a roghnú ón liosta taifeadtaí chun iad a chur go tapa leis an gclár reatha. [[ It can be useful for some communicators to record words or phrases that they will want to use more easily in the future. You can select phrases from the list of recordings to have them quickly added to the current board.

aac_intro_1: Go raibh maith agat as clárú le haghaidh %app_name%! Tá sceitimíní orainn go bhfuil tú anseo agus tá súil againn go ndéanfaidh %app_name% difríocht. Sula gcuirfimid isteach ar roinnt bunúsacha %app_name%, bhíomar ag iarraidh beagán cainte a dhéanamh faoi AAC. [[ Thanks for signing up for %app_name%! We're excited you're here and hope %app_name% makes a difference. Before we get into some %app_name% basics, we wanted to talk a little about AAC.
aac_intro_2: Uirlis is ea AAC (Cumarsáid Mhéadaithe agus Mhalartach) chun cuidiú le daoine atá ag forbairt cumarsáidí a chloisteáil. Is cineál AAC é %app_name% ina roghnaíonn tú cnaipí a léiríonn focail nó litreacha agus labhraíonn an gléas cibé rud a roghnaíonn an t-úsáideoir. [[ AAC (Augmentative and Alternative Communication) is a tool to help developing communicators be heard. %app_name% is a type of AAC where you select buttons that represent words or letters and the device speaks whatever the user selects.
aac_board_examples: Samplaí Boird AAC [[ AAC Board Examples
aac_intro_22: Is féidir le AAC difríocht mhór a dhéanamh do dhaoine a bhfuil am crua acu ag labhairt leo féin. Go hidéalach d’fhéadfadh úsáideoirí roghnú as aon fhocal san fhoclóir, ach mura bhfuil an litriú mar rogha, ní mór dúinn na focail agus na frásaí cearta a roghnú go cúramach chun cabhrú le gach duine cumarsáid éifeachtach a dhéanamh. [[ AAC can make a huge difference for people who have a hard time speaking on their own. Ideally users could pick from any word in the dictionary, but if spelling isn't an option, we need to carefully choose the right words and phrases to best help each individual communicate effectively.
aac_intro_3: In %app_name% cuirimid focail agus frásaí ar chnaipí atá eagraithe mar bhailiúchán "clár". Tá tacair boird éagsúla ann do go leor úsáideoirí agus riachtanais éagsúla. [[ In %app_name% we put words and phrases on buttons that are organized as a collection of "boards". There are different board sets for many different users and needs.
choosing_vocabulary: Roghnú na Stór Focal Ceart [[ Choosing the Right Vocabulary
core_words_1: Tá sé tábhachtach úsáideoir a thosú leis na focail chearta -- agus deacair! Conas a shocraíonn tú cé na focail ba chóir a bheith ag duine éigin? [[ Starting a user with the right words is important -- and hard! How do you decide which words someone should have at their fingertips?
core_words_2: Smaoiníonn go leor daoine ar dtús faoi chumarsáid bunaithe ar riachtanais ("Ní mór dom dul go dtí an seomra folctha", "tá mé gortaithe", "tá ocras orm"), agus is rudaí tábhachtacha iad seo le bheith in ann a chur in iúl. Mar sin féin, tá sé an-luachmhar freisin iarracht a dhéanamh focail choiteanna a chur san áireamh is féidir a úsáid ar níos mó ná bealach amháin. Glaoimid focail "lárnacha" ar na cineálacha focail seo. [[ Many people think first about needs-based communication ("I need to go to the bathroom", "I am hurting", "I am hungry"), and these are important things to be able to express. However, it's also very valuable to try to include common words that can be used in more than one way. We call these types of words "core" words.
core_words_3: Is éard atá i gcroífhocail ná focail cosúil le "tú", "mé", "is maith liom", "ní", "téigh", "isteach", etc. B'fhéidir nach cosúil go bhfuil siad chomh úsáideach láithreach, ach le himeacht ama d'úsáideoir atá faoi lé croí. is féidir le focail go leor smaointe éagsúla a chur in iúl ("Is maith liom é", "ní theastaíonn uait", "gheofá é", "cén uair is féidir linn dul ann") agus a stór focal a dhoimhniú ar bhealach níos éifeachtaí. [[ Core words are words like "you", "I", "like", "not", "go", "in", etc. They may not seem as useful right away, but over time a user who is exposed to core words can express many different ideas ("I like it", "not want", "you get it", "when can we go there") and more effectively deepen their vocabulary.
core_words_4: Bíonn gach úsáideoir difriúil, ach is minic gur féidir le meascán d’fhocail agus frásaí lárnacha agus speisialaithe cuidiú le cumarsáidí a gcuid cainte a mhéadú de réir a chéile, in ionad a bheith i bhfostú gan ach riachtanais agus mianta a chur in iúl. [[ Every user is different, but a combination of core and specialized words and phrases can often help a communicator grow their expression gradually, instead of being stuck only expressing needs and wants.
selecting_a_home_board: Bord Tí a Roghnú [[ Selecting a Home Board
home_board_1: Tá roinnt clár baile éagsúil ag %app_name% ar féidir leat tosú á n-úsáid láithreach, nó iad a chóipeáil agus a oiriúnú de réir mar a théann tú ar aghaidh. Tá cúpla cnaipí móra ag roinnt boird, agus tá go leor cnaipí beaga ag cuid acu. [[ %app_name% has a number of different home boards that you can start using right away, or copy and personalize as you go. Some boards have a few large buttons, and some have many small buttons.
home_board_2: Ciallaíonn níos mó cnaipí níos mó roghanna le haghaidh cur in iúl, ach tá roinnt úsáideoirí teoranta ó thaobh cé chomh beag agus is féidir le cnaipe a bhuail go hiontaofa (cuimhnigh gur féidir leat cnaipí a cheilt i gcónaí ar mhaith leat a chur leis níos déanaí, mar sin d'fhéadfadh bord a bhfuil cuma "róghnóthach" air. i ndáiríre rud ar féidir leo fás isteach ann le himeacht ama). [[ More buttons means more options for expression, but some users are limited in how small a button they can reliably hit (keep in mind you can always hide buttons for now that you want to add later, so a board that looks "too busy" may actually be something they can grow into over time).
speak_mode_2: Nuair a bhíonn tú i Mód Labhairt is féidir leat cnaipí a bhualadh chun iad a labhairt, agus iad a chur leis an mbosca gutha ag an mbarr. Má bhuaileann tú an bosca gutha labhróidh sé na cnaipí go léir atá suite ann. Is féidir leis an gcúlspás agus na cnaipí soiléire cuidiú leis an bhfuinneog abairte a choinneáil glan. [[ When you're in Speak Mode you can hit buttons to have them spoken, and added to the vocalization box at the top. If you hit the vocalization box it'll speak all the buttons that are located there. The backspace and clear buttons can help keep the sentence window clean.
app_speak_mode_folders: %app_name% Fillteáin Mhód Speak [[ %app_name% Speak Mode Folders
speak_mode_22: Is cnaipí nasctha iad na cnaipí a bhfuil deilbhín fillteán beag orthu, rud a chiallaíonn má roghnaíonn tú iad go dtógfaidh sé chuig bord eile tú. Ligeann sé seo duit leibhéil iolracha a bheith agat, le níos mó focal agus frásaí ná mar a d’fhéadfadh a bheith oiriúnach ar scáileán amháin. Is féidir leat filleadh ar an gcéad chlár i gcónaí ach an cnaipe baile a bhualadh. [[ Buttons that have a little folder icon on them are linked buttons, which means that if you select them it will take you to another board. This lets you have multiple levels, with more words and phrases than could fit on a single screen. You can always get back to the first board by hitting the home button.

speak_mode_3: Is féidir leat éirí as Mód Labhair trí bhualadh ar an roghchlár úsáideora sa chúinne uachtarach ar dheis. Má tá imní ort faoi úsáideoir a fhágann Mód Speak de thaisme ina n-aonar, is féidir leat PIN a shocrú i sainroghanna an úsáideora. [[ You can exit out of Speak Mode by hitting the user menu in the top right corner. If you're worried about a user accidentally exiting Speak Mode on their own, you can set up a PIN in the user's preferences.
intro_modeling_3: In %app_name%, tugtar "maoirseoirí" ar an bhfoireann tacaíochta timpeall an chumarsáide. Is úsáideoirí iad maoirseoirí atá ag samhaltú le haghaidh cumarsáide agus ag obair le cumarsáidí. Tá a logáil isteach féin acu, agus d'fhéadfadh sé a bheith ina mhúinteoir nó ina theiripeoir, ina thuismitheoir, ina cúramóir, etc. [[ In %app_name%, the support team around the communicator are called "supervisors". Supervisors are users that are modeling for and working with a communicator. They have their own login, and might be a teacher or a therapist, a parent, a caregiver, etc.
intro_modeling_4: Cuirtear maoirseoirí lena gcuntas cumarsáide, agus is féidir leo cláir chumarsáide a fheiceáil ar a ngléasanna féin, ionas gur féidir leo a bheith compordach le stór focal úsáideora le haghaidh samhaltú níos fearr, agus is féidir leo cnaipí agus frásaí nua a chur leis má tá cead eagarthóireachta acu. [[ Supervisors are added to their communicator's account, and can see a communicator's boards on their own devices, so they can get comfortable with a user's vocabulary for better modeling, and can add new buttons and phrases if they have editing permission.
logging_and_report: Logáil agus Tuarascálacha [[ Logging and Reports
reports_1: Is féidir le maoirseoirí athbhreithniú a dhéanamh ar stair cumarsáide úsáideora freisin. Ar chúiseanna príobháideachta díchumasaítear logaí agus tuarascálacha de réir réamhshocraithe, ach má chumasaíonn tú iad is féidir le maoirseoirí an úsáideora a fheiceáil conas atá a gcumarsáid ag dul chun cinn le himeacht ama. [[ Supervisors can also review a user's communication history. For privacy reasons logs and reports are disabled by default, but if you enable them then the user's supervisors can see how their communication is progressing over time.
app_logs_and_notes: %app_name% Logchomhaid agus Nótaí [[ %app_name% Logs and Notes
reports_2: Chomh maith le stair úsáide a athbhreithniú, is féidir le maoirseoirí rochtain a fháil ar thuairiscí mionsonraithe ar gach seisiún cumarsáide, agus is féidir leo nótaí a dhéanamh agus a roinnt le foireann an úsáideora, ionas go mbeidh a fhios ag gach duine cad é an straitéis reatha agus cad atá nó nach bhfuil ag obair go maith. [[ In addition to reviewing usage history, supervisors can access detailed reports on each communication session, and can make and share notes with the user's team, so everyone knows what the current strategy is and what is or isn't working well.

have_you_tried_modeling: Ar Bhain Tú Bain triail as samhaltú? [[ Have You Tried Modeling?
modeling_intro_1: Is cosúil go mór le foghlaim conas foclóir AAC a úsáid agus teanga nua a fhoghlaim. Bíonn sé i bhfad níos éasca nuair a úsáideann na daoine thart timpeall ort é freisin! Is féidir leat cabhrú trí shamhaltú, a thaispeánann samplaí de conas é a chur chugainn ("seo conas a d'fhéadfá é seo a rá" agus ansin buail na cnaipí duit féin). Uaireanta tógann sé go leor samhaltú sula leanann cumarsáidí do shampla, mar sin déan iarracht a bheith foighneach! [[ Learning to use an AAC vocabulary is a lot like learning a new language. It's much easier when the people around you use it too! You can help by modeling, which is showing examples of how to us it ("here's how you could say this" and then hit the buttons yourself). Sometimes it takes a lot of modeling before a communicator follows your example, so try to be patient!
modeling_intro_2: Agus tú ag samhaltú beidh tú ag iarraidh a chinntiú go bhfuil tú i mód samhaltaithe, ionas gur féidir le %app_name% an difríocht idir do chuid cainte agus cainte an chumarsáide a insint. Is féidir leat "múnla" a dhéanamh ar chumarsáidí ar do dheais, nó is féidir leat an cnaipe soiléir a thapáil faoi thrí chun dul isteach sa mhód samhaltaithe go sealadach. Bain triail as agus féach duit féin! [[ When modeling you'll want to make sure you're in modeling mode, so %app_name% can tell the difference between your speech and the communicator's. You can "model for" a communicator in your dashboard, or you can triple-tap the clear button to temporarily go into modeling mode. Give it a try and see for yourself!

privacy_updated: Nuashonraithe Deiridh: 30 Lúnasa, 2026 [[ Last Updated: August 30, 2026
privacy_intro: Tá LingoLinq LLC (“LingoLinq,” “muid,” “linn,” nó “ár”) tiomanta go mór do do phríobháideacht. Baineann an Polasaí Príobháideachta seo lenár suíomh Gréasáin (www.lingolinq.com) agus le táirgí, bogearraí agus feidhmchláir LingoLinq (dá ngairtear an “Táirge” le chéile). [[ LingoLinq LLC ("LingoLinq," "we," "us," or "our") is deeply committed to your privacy. This Privacy Policy applies to our website (www.lingolinq.com) and LingoLinq's products, software, and applications (collectively, the "Product").
privacy_compliance: Ós rud é go n-úsáidtear LingoLinq ar fud an domhain i suíomhanna oideachais agus leighis, cuirimid cleachtais dhian um chosaint sonraí i bhfeidhm atá deartha chun cloí le rialacháin áitiúla, cónaidhme agus idirnáisiúnta, lena n-áirítear COPPA, FERPA, HIPAA, GDPR (an Eoraip), agus CCPA (California). [[ Because LingoLinq is utilized globally in educational and medical settings, we employ stringent data protection practices designed to comply with local, federal, and international regulations, including COPPA, FERPA, HIPAA, GDPR (Europe), and CCPA (California).
privacy_philosophy: Is simplí ár bpríomhfhealsúnacht príobháideachta: ní choimeádaimid trascríbhinní de do chomhráite mura gcuireann tú gné ar siúl a bhfuil gá leo, agus déantar aon sonraí úsáide a bhailímid chun ár dTáirge a fheabhsú a anaithnidiú go docht agus teastaíonn do rogha isteach sainráite uait. Tá na heisceachtaí liostaithe faoin Ráthaíocht "Smaointe Príobháideacha" thíos, agus is féidir gach ceann acu a mhúchadh. [[ Our core privacy philosophy is simple: we do not keep transcripts of your conversations unless you switch on a feature that needs them, and any usage data we collect to improve our Product is strictly anonymized and requires your explicit opt-in. The exceptions are listed under the "Private Thoughts" Guarantee below, and each one can be switched off.
privacy_agreement: Trí úsáid a bhaint as an Táirge, aontaíonn tú le bailiú agus úsáid do chuid faisnéise mar a thuairiscítear sa pholasaí seo. [[ By using the Product, you agree to the collection and use of your information as described in this policy.
privacy_guarantee_heading: 1. Ráthaíocht Príobháideachta LingoLinq [[ 1. The LingoLinq Privacy Guarantee
privacy_guarantee_thoughts_heading: An Ráthaíocht "Smaointe Príobháideacha": [[ The "Private Thoughts" Guarantee:
privacy_guarantee_thoughts: De réir réamhshocraithe, ní choinníonn LingoLinq trascríbhinní de chomhráite cumarsáideora. Tá dhá eisceacht ann, agus b'fhearr linn a lua go soiléir ná iad a chur i bhfolach. Ar dtús, logáil úsáide: tá sé seo múchta mura gcuireann tú air é, agus tógann sé céim dheimhnithe ar leithligh chun é a chasadh air, ach agus é ar siúl, stóráilimid téacs gach ráitis agus lipéad gach cnaipe a bhrúitear, criptithe, agus déanaimid tuarascálacha agus staitisticí a tháirgeadh uathu. Ar an dara dul síos, tuar focal AI: agus é ar siúl, déantar gach iarratas tuar a shroicheann an díoltóir AI a thaifeadadh, agus áirítear sa taifead sin suas le 200 carachtar den abairt atá á scríobh, agus sonraí aitheantais is féidir linn a bhrath scagtha amach ar dtús; coimeádtar é chun a thaispeáint cad a seoladh agus cathain, agus ní dhéantar iarratais a fhreagraímid ónár dtaisce féin a thaifeadadh. Is féidir gach ceann díobh seo a mhúchadh i do chuid sainroghanna. Seachas iad, is leatsa amháin do chuid smaointe agus focal. [[ By default LingoLinq does not keep transcripts of a communicator's conversations. There are two exceptions, which we would rather state plainly than bury. First, usage logging: this is off unless you turn it on, and turning it on takes a separate confirmation step, but while it is on we store the text of each utterance and the label of each button pressed, encrypted, and we produce reports and statistics from them. Second, AI word prediction: while it is on, each prediction request that actually reaches the AI vendor is recorded, and that record includes up to 200 characters of the sentence being composed, with identifying details we can detect filtered out first; it is kept to show what was sent and when, and requests we answer from our own cache are not recorded. Each of these can be switched off in your preferences. Apart from them, your thoughts and words are yours alone.
privacy_guarantee_separation_heading: Deighilt Dhocht Úsáideoirí: [[ Strict Separation of Users:
privacy_guarantee_separation: Déanaimid scaradh dlíthiúil agus teicniúil idir sonraí an "Riarthóra Cuntais" (e.g., an tuismitheoir, an teiripeoir, nó ceantar na scoile) agus an "Cumarsáideoir" (úsáideoir an AAC). Ní bhaineann margaíocht, sonraí billeála, agus fianáin láithreáin ghréasáin ach leis an Riarthóir Cuntais. Tá comhéadan an Chumarsáideora saor ó phicteilíní rianaithe, fógraíocht agus margaíocht. [[ We legally and technically separate the data of the "Account Administrator" (e.g., the parent, therapist, or school district) from the "Communicator" (the AAC user). Marketing, billing data, and website cookies apply only to the Account Administrator. The Communicator's interface is free of tracking pixels, advertising, and marketing.
privacy_collect_heading: 2. Faisnéis a Bhailímid [[ 2. Information We Collect
privacy_collect_intro: Bailímid an fhaisnéis phearsanta íosta is gá chun LingoLinq a oibriú go slán: [[ We collect the minimum personal information needed to operate LingoLinq securely:
privacy_collect_account: Chun logáil isteach slán a bhunú, bailímid an t-ainm úsáideora, an seoladh ríomhphoist, agus an pasfhocal ón Riarthóir Cuntais. (Molaimid d'eagraíochtaí ainmneacha úsáideora gan ainm a úsáid do Communicators). [[ To establish a secure login, we collect the username, email address, and password from the Account Administrator. (We encourage organizations to use anonymized usernames for Communicators).
privacy_collect_ugc_heading: Ábhar a Ghintear ag Úsáideoirí: [[ User-Generated Content:
privacy_collect_ugc: Stóráiltear cláir stór focal, cnaipí saincheaptha, achoimrí próifíle, agus meáin uaslódáilte go slán le go mbeidh rochtain orthu ar fud gléasanna éagsúla. [[ Vocabulary boards, custom buttons, profile summaries, and uploaded media are stored securely for access across various devices.
privacy_collect_biometric_heading: Sonraí Bithmhéadracha & Braiteoirí (Próiseáil Áitiúil Amháin): [[ Biometric & Sensor Data (Local Processing Only):
privacy_collect_biometric: Má tá sé cumasaithe le haghaidh inrochtaineachta, úsáideann LingoLinq braiteoirí gléis le haghaidh suíomh an chinn, breathnú súl, agus rianú léirithe aghaidhe. Ní bhailímid, ní stórálaimid ná ní roinnimid Aitheantóirí Bithmhéadracha ná Faisnéis Bhithmhéadrach. Próiseáiltear na sonraí seo go dinimiciúil ar do ghléas áitiúil chun roghnú scáileáin a éascú agus caitear iad láithreach. [[ If enabled for accessibility, LingoLinq uses device sensors for head position, eye gaze, and facial expression tracking. We do not collect, store, or share Biometric Identifiers or Biometric Information. This data is processed dynamically on your local device to facilitate screen selection and is immediately discarded.
privacy_collect_analytics_heading: Anailísíocht Aipeanna Gan Ainm: [[ Anonymized App Analytics:
privacy_collect_analytics: Má roghnaíonn tú go sainráite, bailímid sonraí teileamaitreachta uathoibrithe, ginearálaithe (e.g., cé chomh minic a úsáidtear gnéithe áirithe den aip). Baintear aitheantóirí pearsanta de na sonraí seo agus cuirtear le chéile iad i bhformáid chomhiomlán chun cabhrú linn an Táirge a fheabhsú. [[ If you explicitly opt-in, we collect automated, generalized telemetry data (e.g., how often certain app features are used). This data is stripped of personal identifiers and pooled into an aggregate format to help us improve the Product.
privacy_use_heading: 3. Conas a Úsáidimid Do Chuid Faisnéise [[ 3. How We Use Your Information
privacy_use_intro: Úsáidimid an fhaisnéis a bhailímid chun: [[ We use the information we collect to:
privacy_use_provide: Do chuntas LingoLinq ar leith a sholáthar, fabhtcheartú a dhéanamh air agus tacaíocht a thabhairt dó; [[ Provide, troubleshoot, and support your specific LingoLinq account;
privacy_use_sync: Sioncrónaigh agus cúltacaigh d’Ábhar a Ghintear ag Úsáideoirí go slán ar fud do ghléasanna; [[ Sync and back up your User-Generated Content securely across your devices;
privacy_use_share: Comhroinnt shlán a éascú idir cumarsáideoir agus a bhfoireann tacaíochta údaraithe (e.g., teiripeoirí ainmnithe nó tuismitheoirí) amháin; [[ Facilitate secure sharing only between a communicator and their authorized support team (e.g., designated therapists or parents);
privacy_use_legal: Cloí le hoibleagáidí dlíthiúla agus forfheidhmiú ár dTéarmaí Úsáide. [[ Comply with legal obligations and enforce our Terms of Use.
privacy_sharing_heading: 4. Comhroinnt & Próiseálaithe Tríú Páirtí [[ 4. Sharing & Third-Party Processors
privacy_sharing_intro: Ní roinnimid faisnéis ach le húsáideoirí údaraithe (amhail maoirseoirí sannta) agus soláthraithe seirbhíse tríú páirtí fíoraithe a chabhraíonn linn LingoLinq a oibriú. Tá na soláthraithe seo faoi cheangal ag Comhaontuithe Próiseála Sonraí (DPAanna) dochta. Ní sheoltar aon Fhaisnéis Phearsanta Inaitheanta (PII) ná Faisnéis Sláinte Chosanta (PHI) chuig ár soláthraithe anailísíochta riamh. [[ We only share information with authorized users (like assigned supervisors) and vetted third-party service providers who help us operate LingoLinq. These providers are bound by strict Data Processing Agreements (DPAs). No Personally Identifiable Information (PII) or Protected Health Information (PHI) is ever sent to our analytics providers.
privacy_sharing_cloud_heading: Óstáil & Stóráil Néil: [[ Cloud Hosting & Storage:
privacy_sharing_cloud: le haghaidh óstáil aipeanna lárnacha, bainistíocht bhunachar sonraí slán, agus stóráil comhad criptithe; [[ for core app hosting, secure database management, and encrypted file storage;
privacy_sharing_data: chun cláir a aistriú, agus meáin a thraschódú; [[ for translating boards, and transcoding media;
privacy_sharing_analytics: chun earráidí aipeanna agus sláinte an chórais a rianú (sonraí atá anaithnidithe go docht amháin); [[ for tracking app errors and system health (strictly anonymized data only);
privacy_sharing_support: le haghaidh seirbhís do chustaiméirí agus fógraí ríomhphoist/SMS a bhaineann leis an gcuntas (Riarthóir amháin). [[ for customer service and account-related email/SMS notifications (Admin only).

faq_page_subtitle: Freagraí gearra ar cheisteanna coitianta faoi úsáid LingoLinq. [[ Short answers to common questions about using LingoLinq.
faq_ai_boards_q: Cad iad roinnt boird cainte suimiúla agus tarraingteacha is féidir liom a chruthú trí úsáid a bhaint as giniúint boird AI? [[ What are some interesting and engaging speech boards I can create using AI board generation?
faq_ai_boards_p1: Déanann giniúint boird AI leagan amach tosaigh as cur síos gearr ar féidir leat a chur in eagar—cnaipí, grúpaí, agus cosáin a scagann tú cosúil le haon chlár eile. Bíonn na cláir is tarraingtí ceangailte leis an saol fíor: gnáthamh, áit, duine, nó sprioc ar leith, le stór focal a mbeidh an cumarsáideoir ag iarraidh a úsáid an tseachtain sin i ndáiríre. [[ AI board generation turns a short description into a starter layout you can edit—buttons, groups, and paths you refine like any other board. The most engaging boards are tied to real life: a specific routine, place, person, or goal, with vocabulary the communicator will actually want to use that week.
faq_ai_boards_p2: Bain triail as leideanna a thabhairt do chásanna, ní hamháin do chatagóirí. In ionad "focail bhia" amháin, déan cur síos ar "lón a ordú sa bhialann" nó "sneaiceanna a roghnú tar éis na scoile". Measc focail lárnacha (ba mhaith liom, cabhair, níos mó, stad) le focail imeallacha don nóiméad sin (ailléirge, spíosrach, cárta dochair, comhghleacaí foirne). Coinníonn an chothromaíocht sin na cláir úsáideach i gcomhrá, ní hamháin mar liosta focal statach. [[ Try prompting for situations, not just categories. Instead of only "food words," describe "ordering lunch in the cafeteria" or "choosing a snack after school." Mix core words (want, help, more, stop) with fringe words for that moment (allergy, spicy, debit card, teammate). That balance keeps boards useful in conversation, not just as a static word list.
faq_ai_boards_list_intro: Smaointe a oibríonn go maith i seomraí ranga agus i gclinicí: [[ Ideas that work well in classrooms and clinics:
faq_ai_boards_li_1: Saol laethúil: gnáthamh maidine, tascanna tí, obair bhaile, am codlata—gach ceann le sraith bheag frásaí intuartha. [[ Daily living: morning routine, chores, homework, bedtime—each with a small set of predictable phrases.
faq_ai_boards_li_2: Rannpháirtíocht shóisialta: cluichí clós súgartha, cruinnithe club, glaonna físe leis an teaghlach, comhrá beag le comharsana. [[ Social participation: playground games, club meetings, video calls with family, small talk with neighbors.
faq_ai_boards_li_3: Rochtain phobail: siopa grósaera, bialann, cógaslann, leabharlann—scripteanna le haghaidh ceisteanna, roghanna agus réiteach fadhbanna. [[ Community access: grocery store, restaurant, pharmacy, library—scripts for questions, choices, and problem-solving.
faq_ai_boards_li_4: Foghlaim: stór focal eolaíochta d'aonad, comhrá matamaitice (meastachán, comparáid, cruthú), sábháilteacht agus rannpháirtíocht ar thuras allamuigh. [[ Learning: science vocabulary for a unit, math talk (estimate, compare, prove), field trip safety and participation.
faq_ai_boards_li_5: Súgradh agus caitheamh aimsire: rialacha agus casadh do chluichí is fearr leat, lúcháir spóirt, iarratais ar cheachtanna ealaíne nó ceoil. [[ Play and hobbies: rules and turns for favorite games, sports cheers, art or music lesson requests.
faq_ai_boards_li_6: Rialáil agus sláinte: roghanna suaimhneacha, scála pian nó chompord, míniú comharthaí, frásaí ailléirge agus cógais. [[ Regulation and health: calming choices, pain or comfort scale, explaining symptoms, allergy and medication phrases.
faq_ai_boards_p3: Tar éis giniúna, déan eagarthóireacht gan trua: athainmnigh cnaipí i nguth an chumarsáideora, malartaigh siombailí ionas go léifidh siad go tapa, agus nasc ar ais chuig baile cobhsaí nó bord cúltaca. Tosaigh le cás amháin atá tábhachtach an mhí seo, ansin déan dúbláil agus oiriúnaigh nuair a bhraitheann tú compordach. [[ After generation, edit ruthlessly: rename buttons in the communicator's voice, swap symbols so they read quickly, and link back to a stable home or backup board. Start with one situation that matters this month, then duplicate and adapt once it feels comfortable.
faq_aac_q: Cad is AAC ann? (Treoir Shimplí do Thuismitheoirí & Cúramóirí) [[ What Is AAC? (A Simple Guide for Parents & Caregivers)
faq_aac_intro_p1: Má bhíonn deacracht labhartha ag do leanbh—nó ag duine a bhfuil cúram ort dó, b’fhéidir gur chuala tú an téarma AAC. Féadfaidh sé a bheith rómhór ar dtús, ach is éard atá i gceist le AAC ná cabhrú le daoine cumarsáid a dhéanamh ar an mbealach is fearr a oibríonn dóibh. [[ If your child—or someone you care for—has difficulty speaking, you may have heard the term AAC. It can feel overwhelming at first, but AAC is simply about helping people communicate in the way that works best for them.
faq_aac_intro_p2: Sa treoir seo, míneofar duit cad is brí le AAC, cé dó a bhfuil sé, na cineálacha éagsúla atá ar fáil, agus conas a oireann uirlisí cosúil le LingoLinq don phictiúr. [[ This guide will walk you through what AAC means, who it’s for, the different types available, and how tools like LingoLinq fit into the picture.
faq_aac_sub_what_stand: Cad a sheasann AAC dó? [[ What Does AAC Stand For?
faq_aac_stand_for_line: Seasann AAC do Chumarsáid Mhéadaitheach agus Mhalartach. [[ AAC stands for Augmentative and Alternative Communication.
faq_aac_def_augmentative_line: Méadaitheach = ag cur leis an gcaint [[ Augmentative = adding to speech
faq_aac_def_alternative_line: Rogha eile = ag cur cainte in ionad [[ Alternative = replacing speech
faq_aac_simple_terms_lead: I dtéarmaí simplí: [[ In simple terms:
faq_aac_simple_body: Áirítear le AAC aon mhodh cumarsáide a chabhraíonn le duine iad féin a chur in iúl má bhíonn sé deacair labhairt nó mura féidir é. [[ AAC includes any method of communication that helps someone express themselves if speaking is difficult or not possible.
faq_aac_not_just: Ní hamháin do dhaoine “nach féidir leo labhairt” atá AAC ann—tá sé ann d’aon duine a bhfuil tacaíocht de dhíth orthu chun cumarsáid níos éifeachtaí a dhéanamh. [[ AAC is not just for people who “can’t talk”—it’s for anyone who needs support communicating more effectively.
faq_aac_sub_who: Cé dó a bhfuil AAC? [[ Who Is AAC For?
faq_aac_who_intro: Úsáideann daoine de gach aois, ó leanaí óga go daoine fásta, AAC. Is féidir leis tacú le daoine aonair a bhfuil: [[ AAC is used by people of all ages, from young children to adults. It can support individuals with:
faq_aac_who_li_stroke: Stróc nó díobháil inchinne [[ Stroke or brain injury
faq_aac_who_li_als: ALS nó riochtaí meathlúcháin eile [[ ALS or other degenerative conditions
faq_aac_who_li_temp: Cailliúint urlabhra sealadach (gortú, obráid, srl.) [[ Temporary speech loss (injury, surgery, etc.)
faq_aac_who_duration: Úsáideann daoine áirithe AAC go gearrthéarmach, agus bíonn daoine eile ag brath air ar feadh a saoil. [[ Some people use AAC short-term, while others rely on it throughout their lives.
faq_aac_important_label: Tábhachtach a fhios [[ Important to know
faq_aac_important_label_colon: Tábhachtach a fhios: [[ Important to know:
faq_aac_important_body: Ní chuireann úsáid AAC cosc ar dhuine foghlaim conas labhairt. I go leor cásanna, tacaíonn sé le forbairt urlabhra agus feabhsaíonn sé í i ndáiríre. [[ Using AAC does not stop someone from learning to speak. In many cases, it actually supports and improves speech development.
faq_aac_types_intro: Is féidir AAC a roinnt ina dhá phríomhchatagóir: [[ AAC can be broken into two main categories:
faq_aac_sub_low_tech: 1. AAC Gan Teicneolaíocht / Ísealtheicneolaíocht [[ 1. No-Tech / Low-Tech AAC
faq_aac_low_tech_desc: Ní theastaíonn leictreonaic uathu seo. [[ These do not require electronics.
faq_aac_low_ex_gestures: Gothaí (ag pointeáil, ag sméideadh) [[ Gestures (pointing, nodding)
faq_aac_low_ex_books: Leabhair chumarsáide clóite [[ Printed communication books
faq_aac_low_pro_1: Simplí agus iontaofa [[ Simple and reliable
faq_aac_low_pro_2: Gan cadhnraí ná socruithe [[ No batteries or setup
faq_aac_low_con_2: Níos deacra oiriúnú go tapa [[ Harder to adapt quickly
faq_aac_high_tech_desc: Is uirlisí nó aipeanna leictreonacha iad seo a chabhraíonn le daoine cumarsáid a dhéanamh. [[ These are electronic tools or apps that help people communicate.
faq_aac_high_ex_tablet: Aipeanna AAC bunaithe ar tháibléid [[ Tablet-based AAC apps
faq_aac_high_ex_gaze: Córais rianaithe súl nó córais bunaithe ar fhaire [[ Eye-tracking or gaze-based systems
faq_aac_high_pro_1: Stór focal níos mó [[ Larger vocabulary
faq_aac_high_pro_2: Is féidir urlabhra a ghiniúint [[ Can generate speech
faq_aac_high_con_1: Éilíonn sé socrú agus foghlaim [[ Requires setup and learning
faq_aac_high_con_2: D’fhéadfadh sé a bheith níos costasaí [[ May be more expensive
faq_aac_sub_how_works: Conas a Oibríonn AAC i ndáiríre [[ How AAC Actually Works
faq_aac_how_p1: Tá formhór na gcóras AAC tógtha timpeall ar bhord cumarsáide — leagan amach cnaipí, siombailí nó focal. [[ Most AAC systems are built around a communication board—a layout of buttons, symbols, or words.
faq_aac_user_li_gaze: Úsáid a súile (rianú stánaidh) [[ Use their eyes (gaze tracking)
faq_aac_system_then_label: An córas ansin: [[ The system then:
faq_aac_system_li_speak: Labhraíonn an focal nó an frása [[ Speaks the word or phrase
faq_aac_system_li_history: Stórálann stair chumarsáide [[ Stores communication history
faq_aac_how_p2: Le himeacht ama, foghlaimíonn úsáideoirí cá bhfuil focail suite agus conas nascleanúint a dhéanamh go tapa—díreach cosúil le clóscríobh ar mhéarchlár. [[ Over time, users learn where words are located and how to navigate quickly—just like typing on a keyboard.
faq_aac_sub_lingolinq: An áit a n-oireann LingoLinq don réimse [[ Where LingoLinq Fits In
faq_aac_ll_intro: Tá LingoLinq mar chuid den chéad ghlúin eile d’uirlisí AAC—atá dírithe ní hamháin ar chumarsáid, ach ar fheabhsú an chaoi a dtarlaíonn cumarsáid. [[ LingoLinq is part of the next generation of AAC tools—focused not just on communication, but on improving how communication happens.
faq_aac_ll_diff_q: Cad a fhágann go bhfuil sé difriúil? [[ What makes it different?
faq_aac_ll_most_focus: Díríonn formhór na n-uirlisí AAC ar: [[ Most AAC tools focus on:
faq_aac_ll_most_li: Cad iad na focail atá roghnaithe [[ What words are selected
faq_aac_ll_also_focus: Díríonn LingoLinq ar: [[ LingoLinq also focuses on:
faq_aac_ll_also_li: Conas a idirghníomhaíonn úsáideoirí leis an mbord [[ How users interact with the board
faq_aac_ll_inc_tap: Cá háit a dtaipeálann úsáideoirí [[ Where users tap
faq_aac_ll_inc_time: Cá fhad a thógann sé focal a aimsiú [[ How long it takes to find a word
faq_aac_ll_inc_reach: Ceantair atá deacair a bhaint amach [[ Areas that are hard to reach

Any use of LingoLinq's AI features by a child under 13, including AI-assisted board generation and AI word prediction, requires verifiable parental consent under 16 CFR Part 312, regardless of school enrollment. home_tour_welcome_text: Déan iniúchadh ar do phainéal rialaithe agus faigh amach cá bhfuil do chuid uirlisí, boird agus gnéithe cumarsáide. [[ Explore your dashboard and learn where your tools, boards, and communication features live.
home_tour_start: Tosaigh an turas [[ Start the tour
home_tour_nav_text: Athraigh idir Baile, Cláir, Tuarascálacha, agus Breiseáin ón nascleanúint barr seo. [[ Switch between Home, Boards, Reports, and Extras from this top nav.
home_tour_page_home_text: Baile do phainéil rialaithe — lean ar aghaidh san áit ar fhág tú é, oscail Mód Labhra, agus faigh na huirlisí is mó a úsáideann tú go tapa. [[ Your dashboard home — pick up where you left off, open Speak Mode, and reach your most-used tools at a glance.
home_tour_page_boards_text: Brabhsáil, cruthaigh agus eagraigh do chláir chumarsáide (tacair leathanach). Oscail aon chlár chun é a fheiceáil nó a chur in eagar. [[ Browse, create, and organize your communication boards (page-sets). Open any board to view or edit it.
home_tour_page_reports_text: Rianaigh úsáid agus dul chun cinn — gníomhaíocht chumarsáide agus sonraí focal do na daoine a dtacaíonn tú leo. [[ Track usage and progress — communication activity and word data for the people you support.
home_tour_page_extras_text: Bíonn cluichí, ceachtanna, socruithe cuntais, agus uirlisí úsáideacha eile anseo aon uair a bhíonn siad de dhíth ort. [[ Games, lessons, account settings, and other helpful tools live here whenever you need them.
home_tour_caseload_text: Léim díreach chuig na daoine a dtacaíonn tú leo. Cuir nóta leis, déan measúnú tapa, nó déan samhail i mód labhartha. [[ Jump straight to the people you support. Add a note, run a quick assessment, or model in speak mode.
home_tour_speak_title: Oscail Mód Labhra [[ Open Speak Mode
home_tour_speak_text: Osclaíonn Lean ar Ag Labhairt do chlár baile i mód cumarsáide, réidh le húsáid go laethúil. [[ Continue Speaking opens your home board in communication mode, ready for everyday use.
home_tour_boards_title: Bainistigh do chláir [[ Manage your boards
home_tour_boards_text: Cruthaigh, brabhsáil agus eagraigh cláir. Tá do chlár baile bioráilte ag tosaigh an stiall. [[ Create, browse, and organize boards. Your home board is pinned at the front of the strip.
home_tour_extras_title: Tuilleadh uirlisí i mBreiseáin [[ More tools in Extras
home_tour_extras_text: Aimsigh cluichí, ceachtanna, socruithe cuntais, agus tuilleadh faoi Bhreiseáin aon uair a bhíonn siad de dhíth ort. [[ Find games, lessons, account settings, and more under Extras whenever you need them.
home_tour_orgs_text: Más tú féin a riarann eagraíocht amháin nó níos mó de LingoLinq, téigh isteach anseo chun baill, seomraí agus ceadúnais a bhainistiú. [[ If you administer one or more LingoLinq organizations, jump in here to manage members, rooms, and licenses.
home_tour_done_text: Sin é an turas. Is féidir leat cuairt a thabhairt air arís am ar bith ón gcnaipe Glac turas ag barr an phainéil. [[ That's the tour. You can revisit it anytime from the Take a tour button at the top of the dashboard.
preparing_your_board: Ag Ullmhú do Bhord [[ Preparing your Board
loading_board_layout: Ag luchtú leagan amach an bhoird nua-aimseartha [[ Loading the modern board layout
beta_welcome_greeting_named: Haigh %{name}, tá áthas orainn go bhfuil tú anseo. [[ Hi %{name}, we're glad you're here.
beta_welcome_greeting_generic: Tá áthas orainn go bhfuil tú anseo chun cabhrú linn LingoLinq a thógáil. [[ We're so glad you're here to help us build LingoLinq.
beta_welcome_intro: Go raibh maith agat as páirt a ghlacadh sa béite. Táimid ag tógáil LingoLinq le húsáideoirí AAC, teiripeoirí, múinteoirí agus teaghlaigh, agus cabhraíonn d’aiseolas linn feabhas a chur ar a bhfuil á sheoladh againn. [[ Thanks for joining the beta. We're building LingoLinq with AAC users, therapists, teachers, and families, and your feedback helps us improve what we ship.
beta_welcome_explore_title: Dhá bhealach ar féidir linn iniúchadh a dhéanamh le chéile [[ Two ways we can explore together
beta_welcome_explore_speak_title: Labhair, imir & faigh amach [[ Speak, play & discover
beta_welcome_explore_speak_body: Tá ceadúnas oifigiúil fánaíochta agat! Déan iniúchadh, bain triail as rudaí, agus faigh amach conas is maith leat labhairt, roinnt agus cumarsáid a dhéanamh. [[ You have an official license to roam! Explore, try things out, and find how you like to talk, share, and communicate.
beta_welcome_explore_missions_body: Gach seachtain roinnfimid gníomhaíocht ghearr ionas gur féidir linn cleachtadh a dhéanamh ar ghnéithe éagsúla le chéile. [[ Each week we'll share a short activity so we can practice using different features together.
beta_welcome_step_tour_title: Féach ar an turas gairid [[ Watch the quick tour
beta_welcome_step_tour_body: Chuireamar físeán gearr le chéile chun a thaispeáint conas a oibríonn gach rud agus chun cabhrú leat mothú ar do shuaimhneas. [[ We put together a short video to show how everything works and help you feel at ease.
beta_welcome_step_popups_title: Pop-ups ar an mbealach [[ Pop-ups along the way
beta_welcome_step_popups_body: Ar fud na haipe, míníonn teachtaireachtaí cabhracha gnéithe de réir mar a théann tú ar aghaidh. Cosúil le bileog cheat ón gcéad lá. [[ Throughout the app, helpful messages explain features as you go. Like a cheat sheet from day one.
beta_welcome_step_agreement_title: Píosa beag tíghrafaíochta [[ A quick bit of housekeeping
beta_welcome_step_agreement_body: Ar an scáileán seo chugainn feicfidh tú comhaontú gearr i mBéarla simplí. Déan athbhreithniú air agus glac leis nuair a bheidh tú réidh, nó déan teagmháil linn má tá aon cheist agat. [[ On the next screen you'll see a short agreement in plain English. Please review it and accept when you're ready, or contact us with any questions.
beta_welcome_step_signed_in_title: Tá tú logáilte isteach [[ You're signed in
beta_welcome_step_signed_in_body: Nuair a bheidh an comhaontú críochnaithe agat, rachaidh tú isteach i LingoLinq agus is féidir leat tosú ag iniúchadh láithreach. [[ When you finish the agreement, you'll head into LingoLinq and can start exploring right away.
beta_welcome_feedback_title: Conas do chuid smaointe a roinnt [[ How to share your thoughts
beta_welcome_feedback_body: Má aimsíonn tú fadhb, má thugann tú faoi deara fabht, nó má tá smaoineamh agat, bain úsáid as an gcnaipe Aiseolas Béite san aip. Níl aon mhionsonra róbheag! [[ If you find a problem, catch a bug, or have an idea, use the Beta Feedback button inside the app. No detail is too small!
beta_welcome_signoff: Go raibh maith agat as cabhrú linn an guth nua seo a mhúnlú agus as a bheith i do chuid ríthábhachtach dár bhfoireann! [[ Thank you for helping us shape this new voice and being a vital part of our crew!
beta_agreement_title: Comhaontú Tástála Béite LingoLinq [[ LingoLinq Beta Test Agreement
beta_agreement_subtitle: Téarmaí simplí dár bpobal béite. Léigh le do thoil sula leanann tú ar aghaidh. [[ Plain-language terms for our beta community. Please read before you continue.
beta_agreement_lead: Fáilte go dtí an fhoireann! Sula dtosaímid ag tástáil LingoLinq le chéile, féach ar an gcomhaontú gairid seo le do thoil. Trí leanúint ar aghaidh, aontaíonn tú leis na téarmaí seo: [[ Welcome to the team! Before we start testing LingoLinq together, please look over this short agreement. By continuing, you agree to these terms:
beta_agreement_open_source_title: Foinse oscailte & comhroinnt [[ Open source & sharing
beta_agreement_share_title: Roinn do thuras: [[ Share your journey:
beta_agreement_share_body: Is foinse oscailte é LingoLinq. Molaimid duit scáileáin, físeáin agus léirmheasanna a roinnt chun cabhrú le sceitimíní a chothú. [[ LingoLinq is open source. We encourage you to share screenshots, videos, and reviews to help build excitement.
beta_agreement_ideas_body: Féadfar moltaí agus tuairiscí fabhtanna a úsáid chun LingoLinq a fheabhsú do gach duine, gan aon oibleagáidí breise ort. [[ Suggestions and bug reports may be used to improve LingoLinq for everyone, without extra obligations to you.
beta_agreement_privacy_title: Príobháideacht & sonraí a choinneáil slán [[ Privacy & keeping data safe
beta_agreement_privacy_body: Chun do ghlór a thógáil ar an mbealach is fearr is féidir, ní mór dúinn tuiscint a fháil ar an gcaoi a n-oibríonn sé i gcásanna fíorshaoil. Féadfaidh ár n-innealtóirí sonraí cumarsáide agus cúlra (teileiméadracht) a úsáid chun fabhtanna a shocrú agus luas a fheabhsú. Cosnaímid na sonraí seo i gcomhréir lenár bhFógra Príobháideachais. [[ To build your voice in the best way possible, we need to understand how it works in real-world situations. Our engineers may use communication and background data (telemetry) to fix bugs and improve speed. We protect this data in accordance with our Privacy Notice.
beta_agreement_logs_body: Baintear ainmneacha agus próifílí pearsanta d'aon logaí cumarsáide a ndéantar athbhreithniú orthu le haghaidh fabhtcheartaithe sula bhfeiceann na hinnealtóirí iad. [[ Any communication logs reviewed for troubleshooting are stripped of names and personal profiles before engineers see them.
beta_agreement_parents_body: Más tuismitheoir tástálaí faoi bhun 13 bliana d’aois thú, comhlánaigh ár dToiliú Tuismitheora Infhíoraithe le linn clárúcháin. [[ If you are a parent of a tester under 13, complete our Verifiable Parental Consent during registration.
beta_agreement_schools_body: I suíomhanna oideachais, cinntigh go bhfuil cead cuí ón gceantar nó toiliú na dtuismitheoirí ann chun go gcomhlíonfar FERPA. [[ In educational settings, ensure proper district approval or parental consent for FERPA compliance.
beta_agreement_clinicians_body: Ná cuir isteach fíor-PHI an othair go dtí go mbeidh BAA sínithe. [[ Do not input real patient PHI until a BAA is signed. Contact
beta_agreement_forgotten_title: Do cheart go ndéanfaí dearmad ort [[ Your right to be forgotten
beta_agreement_forgotten_body: chun do chuntas a scriosadh. Scriosfaimid do PII go buan laistigh de 48 uair an chloig agus ní choimeádfaimid ach sonraí nach féidir a nascadh ar ais leat. [[ to delete your account. We permanently delete your PII within 48 hours and only keep data that cannot be linked back to you.
beta_agreement_safety_title: Nóta sábháilteachta tábhachtach d'úsáideoirí AAC [[ Important safety note for AAC users
beta_agreement_safety_lead: Coinnigh do phríomhghuth ar láimh: [[ Keep your main voice handy:
beta_agreement_safety_body: Is bogearraí réamh-eisiúna é seo — d’fhéadfadh fabhtanna a bheith ann nó tuairteanna a bheith ann ó am go chéile. Coinnigh do phríomhghléas cumarsáide leat mar chúltaca agus muid ag tástáil. Ná bí ag brath ar LingoLinq mar d’aon bhealach le labhairt le linn na céime béite seo. [[ This is pre-release software — it may have bugs or occasionally crash. Please keep your primary communication device with you as a backup while we test. Do not rely on LingoLinq as your only way to talk during this beta phase.
beta_agreement_legal_title: An stuif dlíthiúil [[ The legal stuff
beta_agreement_legal_body: Úsáideann tú an leagan tástála seo ar do phriacal féin. Cuirtear LingoLinq ar fáil mar atá gan bharántais. Fanann an comhaontú seo i bhfeidhm go dtí ár seoladh oifigiúil nó go dtí go dtiocfaidh deireadh leis an gclár béite. [[ You use this test version at your own risk. LingoLinq is provided as-is without warranties. This agreement stays in place until our official launch or until the beta program ends.
beta_agreement_thanks: Go raibh maith agat as ucht oibriú linn chun LingoLinq a thógáil! [[ Thank you for partnering with us to build LingoLinq!
beta_agreement_accept: Léigh mé an Comhaontú Tástála Béite agus glacaim leis. [[ I have read and accept the Beta Test Agreement.
boards_empty_subtitle: Cruthaigh do chéad chlár agus beidh sé le feiceáil anseo. [[ Create your first board and it'll appear here.
english_first_board_hint: Cruthaítear boird i mBéarla ar dtús le go mbeidh dathanna cruinne na siombailí ann. Is féidir leat aistriúchán a dhéanamh tar éis duit iad a shábháil. [[ Boards are created in English first for accurate symbol colors. You can translate after saving.
home_tour_trigger_aria: Tabhair cuairt ar an deais [[ Take a tour of the dashboard
welcome_fill_out_subscription3: Fáilte! Tá 2 mhí saor in aisce de bhreiseáin scamall san áireamh i do chuntas — bain triail as %app_name% sula ndéanann tú gealltanas, nó roghnaigh plean le tosú láithreach. [[ Welcome! Your account includes 2 free months of cloud extras — try %app_name% before committing, or pick a plan to start right away.
board_already_translated_prompt: Tá aistriúcháin ar an mbord seo cheana féin don teanga seo. Úsáid Athraigh go dtí Aistriúchán atá ann cheana féin chun é a dhéanamh mar an teanga réamhshocraithe taispeána agus labhartha. Chun teangacha a athrú, oscail an chóip bhunaidh Béarla den bhord nó bain úsáid as Athraigh Teanga ón roghchlár boird. [[ This board already has translations for this language. Use Switch to Existing Translation to make it the default display and speak language. To change languages, open the original English board copy or use Switch Language from the board menu.

[[ This board is already in %{language}. To view another language, use Switch Language from the board menu or open a translated copy of this board.
telemetry_opt_in: Aontaím go gceadófar sonraí úsáide agus feidhmíochta gan ainm (teileiméadracht) a bhailiú chun cabhrú le LingoLinq a fheabhsú. [[ I agree to allow anonymous usage and performance data (telemetry) to be collected to help improve LingoLinq.
comms_log_opt_in: Aontaím go gceadófar athbhreithniú a dhéanamh ar logaí cumarsáide gan ainm chun fabhtcheartú a dhéanamh agus chun aipeanna a fheabhsú. Baintear ainmneacha agus próifílí pearsanta de na logaí sula ndéantar athbhreithniú orthu ag aon innealtóir. [[ I agree to allow anonymized communication logs to be reviewed for troubleshooting and app improvement. Logs are fully stripped of names and personal profiles before any engineer reviews them.

register_consent_combined_prefix: Tá mé 13 bliana d'aois ar a laghad, léigh mé agus aontaím leis an [[ I am at least 13 years old, have read and agree to the
register_consent_combined_suffix: , agus táim in ann ceangal a dhéanamh le conradh dlíthiúil. [[ , and am capable of binding to a legal contract.
combined_consent_required_message: Ní mór duit d’aois a dheimhniú agus aontú leis na Téarmaí Úsáide chun cuntas a chruthú. [[ You must confirm your age and agree to the Terms of Use to create an account.

eyegaze_tracker_unavailable: Níl an rianaitheoir súl gréasáin ar fáil. Athnuaigh an leathanach agus déan iarracht arís. [[ The webcam eye tracker is not available. Refresh the page and try again.
eyegaze_tracking_failed: Níorbh fhéidir rianú súl a thosú. Seiceáil go bhfuil do cheamara ceangailte agus gur cheadaigh tú rochtain don cheamara. [[ Eye tracking could not start. Check that your camera is connected and that you allowed camera access.
ai_focus_words_requires_online: Éilíonn giniúint focal fócais AI nasc Idirlín. [[ AI focus word generation requires an Internet connection.
ai_focus_description_required: Cuir cur síos leis ionas gur féidir le hintleacht shaorga focail fhócais a ghiniúint. [[ Add a description so AI can generate focus words.
ai_focus_word_count_invalid: Roghnaigh idir 5 agus 50 focal fócais. [[ Choose between 5 and 50 focus words.
share_details_still_loading: Tá sonraí comhroinnte fós á lódáil, déan iarracht arís i gceann nóiméid. [[ Still loading sharing details, please try again in a moment.
copy_board_unavailable: Níl cóipeáil boird ar fáil faoi láthair. [[ Board copying is not available right now.
choose_language_before_copy_translate: Roghnaigh teanga sula ndéantar cóip a aistriú. [[ Choose a language before translating a copy.

translations_applied: Aistriúcháin curtha i bhfeidhm. [[ Translations applied.

beta_welcome_feedback_intro: Mar bhall béite luath, cuidíonn d’aiseolas go díreach le todhchaí uirlisí cumarsáide d’úsáideoirí AAC, do theaghlaigh, do theiripeoirí agus d’oideoirí a mhúnlú. beta_welcome_mission_explore: Iniúchadh a dhéanamh ar chláir chumarsáide [[ Explore communication boards
beta_welcome_mission_tools: Bain triail as uirlisí labhartha, samhaltaithe agus nascleanúna [[ Try speaking, modeling, and navigation tools
beta_welcome_mission_confusing: Inis dúinn cad a bhraitheann mearbhall nó deacair [[ Tell us what feels confusing or difficult
beta_welcome_mission_ideas: Roinn smaointe nó iarratais ar ghnéithe [[ Share ideas or feature requests
beta_welcome_mission_bugs: Tuairiscigh fabhtanna nó aon rud a bhraitheann mí-oiriúnach [[ Report bugs or anything that feels off

beta_welcome_listening_body: Cuidíonn gach smaoineamh, tuairisc fabht, agus breathnóireacht linn uirlisí cumarsáide a thógáil a bhraitheann níos daonna, níos nua-aimseartha agus níos inrochtana. privacy_beta_notice_heading: Fógra faoin gClár Béite [[ Beta Program Notice
privacy_beta_notice_body: Tá an fógra seo i bhfeidhm fad atá LingoLinq i mbéite agus rachaidh sé in éag ag an seoladh ginearálta. Le linn an béite, is bogearraí réamh-eisiúna é LingoLinq a sholáthraítear "mar atá". Coinnigh do phríomh-mhodh cumarsáide ar fáil i gcónaí, agus ná bí ag brath ar LingoLinq mar d'aon mhodh cumarsáide le linn na tréimhse seo. Má roghnaíonn tú isteach, féadfaidh baill foirne údaraithe sonraí úsáide diagnóiseacha gan ainm a athbhreithniú chun fabhtanna a shocrú agus inrochtaineacht a fheabhsú; i gcomhréir lenár Ráthaíocht Smaointe Príobháideacha, ní dhéanaimid athbhreithniú ar na focail ná na habairtí a ghineann cumarsáideoir. I gcás úsáideoirí faoi 13 bliana d'aois, tá toiliú infhíoraithe tuismitheora (nó, i gcás úsáide scoile, údarú oifigiúil scoile) ag teastáil sula mbailítear aon sonraí. Má úsáideann tú LingoLinq le fíorfhaisnéis othar, ba chóir go mbeadh Comhaontú Comhlach Gnó (BAA) i bhfeidhm ag d'eagraíocht linn ar dtús; déan teagmháil linn chun ceann a fhorghníomhú. Is féidir leat iarratas a dhéanamh ar scriosadh do chuntais ag am ar bith, agus leanann am an scriosta na fuinneoga coinneála a thuairiscítear i Roinn 7 thíos. [[ This notice applies while LingoLinq is in beta and expires at general launch. During the beta, LingoLinq is pre-release software provided "as is." Please keep your primary communication method available at all times, and do not rely on LingoLinq as your only means of communication during this period. If you opt in, authorized staff may review anonymized, diagnostic usage data to fix bugs and improve accessibility; consistent with our Private Thoughts Guarantee, we do not review the words or sentences a communicator generates. For users under 13, verifiable parental consent (or, for school use, school-official authorization) is required before any data is collected. If you use LingoLinq with real patient information, your organization should have a Business Associate Agreement (BAA) in place with us first; contact us to execute one. You can request deletion of your account at any time, and deletion timing follows the retention windows described in Section 7 below.
