privacy_sharing_ai: le haghaidh moltaí boird le cúnamh AI, tuar focal, agus, nuair a dhéanann paiteolaí urlabhra-teanga gníomh ar leithligh chun é a iarraidh amháin, achoimrí meastóireachta dréachtaithe ag AI; [[ for AI-assisted board suggestions, word prediction, and, only when a speech-language pathologist takes a separate action to request it, AI-drafted evaluation summaries;
privacy_sharing_ai_vendors: Úsáideann na gnéithe AI a bhfuil cur síos orthu san fhógra seo, is é sin moltaí boird le cúnamh AI, tuar focal, agus achoimrí meastóireachta dréachtaithe ag AI, samhlacha Claude Anthropic atá á n-óstáil ar Amazon Bedrock, laistigh de chuntas AWS atá faoi rialú LingoLinq faoi Chomhaontú Comhlach Gnó sínithe (Claude Haiku 4.5 le haghaidh moltaí boird agus tuar focal). Déileálann seirbhísí Google ar leithligh le trascríobh cainte, sintéis cainte, agus aistriúchán boird; níl siad sin clúdaithe ag na rialuithe sa mhír seo agus tá siad rialaithe ag a socruithe féin. Nuair a úsáideann tú ceann de na gnéithe seo, seoltar an téacs atá de dhíth air chuig AWS trí Amazon Bedrock lena phróiseáil ag samhail Anthropic Claude. Sula seoltar aon rud, scagaimid amach go huathoibríoch sonraí aitheantais choitianta is féidir linn a bhrath, amhail ainmneacha, ríomhphoist, uimhreacha gutháin, agus aitheantóirí cuntais; níl an scagaire seo foirfe, agus déanaimid cur síos ar an toradh mar shonraí scrofa nó ainm bréige, ní an caighdeán dlíthiúil foirmiúil chun gach faisnéis aitheantais a bhaint. Is féidir leat gnéithe AI a mhúchadh do do chuntas féin i do chuid roghanna, is féidir le heagraíocht a bhainistíonn an cuntas iad a mhúchadh do gach duine a bhainistíonn sí, agus i gcás linbh faoi 13 bliana fanann siad blocáilte go dtí go mbeidh an toiliú tuismitheora riachtanach againn. Tá achoimrí meastóireachta dréachtaithe ag AI neamhghníomhach inniu: nuair a iarrtar ceann, cruthaítear dréacht atá scríofa ar ár gcórais féin, agus ní sheoltar aon rud chuig aon díoltóir AI. Dá gcuirfí ar siúl é sin, úsáidfí an cosán céanna Amazon Bedrock agus an scagadh céanna, agus dhéanfaimis an fógra seo a nuashonrú chun an tsamhail a ainmniú sula seoltar aon sonraí meastóireachta. Ar Amazon Bedrock ní fhaigheann an soláthraí samhail an fhaisnéis seo ar chor ar bith, agus deir AWS nach n-úsáidtear í chun aon samhail a oiliúint. Féadfaidh AWS í a choinneáil ar feadh tréimhse teoranta chun sábháilteacht agus chun mí-úsáid a chosc, mar sin ní éilímid ráthaíocht coinneála nialasach sonraí don chosán seo faoi láthair. [[ The AI features described in this notice, meaning AI-assisted board suggestions, word prediction, and AI-drafted evaluation summaries, use Anthropic's Claude models hosted on Amazon Bedrock, inside a LingoLinq-controlled AWS account under a signed Business Associate Agreement (Claude Haiku 4.5 for board suggestions and word prediction). Separate Google services handle speech transcription, speech synthesis, and board translation; those are not covered by the controls in this paragraph and are governed by their own settings. When you use one of these features, the text it needs is sent to AWS through Amazon Bedrock for processing by an Anthropic Claude model. Before anything is sent, we automatically filter out common identifying details we can detect, such as names, emails, phone numbers, and account identifiers; this filter is not perfect, and we describe the result as scrubbed or pseudonymized data, not the formal legal standard for removing all identifying information. You can turn AI features off for your own account in your preferences, an organization that manages the account can turn them off for everyone it manages, and for a child under 13 they stay blocked until we have the required parental consent. AI-drafted evaluation summaries are inactive today: asking for one produces a draft written on our own systems, and nothing is sent to any AI vendor. If we switch that on, it would use the same Amazon Bedrock path and the same filtering, and we would update this notice to name the model before any evaluation data is sent. On Amazon Bedrock the model provider does not receive this information at all, and AWS states it is not used to train any model. AWS may retain it for a limited period for safety and abuse prevention, so we do not currently claim a zero-data-retention guarantee for this path.

landing_mission_statement: Ciallaíonn sé níos mó ná AAC a dhéanamh inrochtana ná bacainní cumarsáide a bhaint. Ciallaíonn sé cumarsáid a dhéanamh níos éasca agus níos tapúla, agus guth, pearsantacht agus intinn gach duine á gcaomhnú ag an am céanna. Tógálaimid ar mhaithe le sábháilteacht, muinín agus príobháideacht, ionas gur féidir le cumarsáideoirí agus na daoine a thacaíonn leo díriú ar an rud is tábhachtaí: ceangal lena chéile. [[ Removing barriers to communication means more than making AAC accessible. It means making communication easier and faster, while preserving each person's voice, personality, and intent. We build for safety, trust, and privacy, so communicators and the people who support them can focus on what matters most: connecting with each other.

[[ We never sell or share your information, and we never use it to train AI models.
